neighbours.label: the word 'invade' and its forms ('invasion', 'invading'), not synonyms like attack, raid or occupy
fire: Every autumn, mice try to invade the old farmhouse kitchen.
Historians still debate why Napoleon chose to invade Russia in 1812.
Bad weather delayed the invasion of the beaches by a day.
Doctors noticed that the tumor had begun to invade nearby tissue.
In the film, aliens invade a small town in Ohio.
Local farmers fear that locusts will invade their fields this spring.
Shortly after the invasion, the capital was occupied.
Rabbits kept invading the vegetable patch all summer.
